# Running plan 2025-02

## Open questions

- Drink before the long run, take a gel after one hour.
- Knee felt sore after the hill session, skip hills this week.
- Weekly distance goes up by at most ten percent.

## Status

- New shoes after 700 kilometres, the old ones are flat.
- Rest day means really resting, a walk is fine.
- Protein with every meal, more vegetables at dinner.

## Context

Stretching after every run, ten minutes, no excuses. Grace joins the Thursday run, slower pace that day. Race goal is to finish under two hours, without walking.
